lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three distinct vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters are visible on the caudal peduncle. The most anterior visible column contains two spots, followed by two columns each containing three spots in a vertical linear arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present on the caudal peduncle, aligning with and intersecting the vertical columns of circular spots.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge (caudal keel) is visible along the lateral midline of the caudal peduncle, displaying a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch or indentation is visible on the posterior margin of the upper caudal lobe near the apex.
other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin surface displays high-luminance spots: approximately seven clusters are visible on the upper lobe and five clusters are visible on the lower lobe.
